migration.migration_reason: Preserved paid Language Quality findings were independently re-adjudicated against the current fixed five-component design rubric. Legacy normalized scores were retained only for audit and were not used to derive component levels. The snapshot is bound to exact source evidence and the current validator recomputes scores.

recertifier.provider_model_provenance_claim: No Anthropic/Sonnet call is claimed for these reconstructed judgments.

component_findings.abstraction_ceremony: Recertified level 3 under the current criterion: Reusable abstractions such as types, interfaces/traits/generics or equivalent mechanisms can be declared and consumed without excessive scaffolding. Evidence basis: Current Quidra uses indentation blocks without braces/semicolons, local auto inference and concise range/collection forms while keeping typed boundaries and explicit error/resource semantics; generic/class/error handling retains deliberate bounded ceremony. Preserved paid evidence additionally records: Recertified level 3 under the current criterion: Reusable abstractions such as types, interfaces/traits/generics or equivalent mechanisms can be declared and consumed without excessive scaffolding. Evidence basis: Current Quidra uses indentation blocks without braces/semicolons, local auto inference and concise range/collection forms while keeping typed boundaries and explicit error/resource semantics; generic/class/error handling retains deliberate bounded ceremony. Preserved paid evidence additionally records: Quidra's block-structured, four-space-indentation, no-parentheses-conditionals surface syntax (if/while/for headers without parens, colon-free suite introduction via indentation) removes common punctuation ceremony found in C-family languages (Java/C++/Kotlin brace-and-paren pairs), and its 'auto' inference, unified int/float family literals, and namespaced math functions keep expressions compact. Overloaded operators (+=, %, string interpolation with '{value}') match Python's terseness for common numeric workloads. Working against conciseness: explicit typed declarations are mandatory for uninitialized/parameter/field bindings (no dynamic typing fallback), and top-level bindings are not implicitly visible inside functions (must be passed explicitly as parameters), which both add a modest, bounded amount of code versus Python for equivalent numeric micro-workloads, whil…

component_findings.consistency_regular_forms: Recertified level 3 under the current criterion: Similar concepts use regular forms with few special-case spellings or context-dependent surface rules. Evidence basis: Current Quidra makes types, writable aliases (&), control flow and error propagation explicit with low punctuation noise and regular forms; a few language-specific spellings and rules still require familiarity. Preserved paid evidence additionally records: Recertified level 3 under the current criterion: Similar concepts use regular forms with few special-case spellings or context-dependent surface rules. Evidence basis: Current Quidra makes types, writable aliases (&), control flow and error propagation explicit with low punctuation noise and regular forms; a few language-specific spellings and rules still require familiarity. Preserved paid evidence additionally records: Quidra source reads as a clean, Python-like block language: mandatory 4-space indentation with no braces or semicolons, explicit typed declarations that make every value's type visible at its declaration site without requiring cross-referencing (unlike Python), explicit '&' for reference/address semantics that makes aliasing and mutation intent visible at call sites (an advantage over both Python and Java's implicit reference semantics for objects), and structured elif/match constructs that avoid nested else-if pyramids. Diagnostics observed during authoring (UNKNOWN_NAME, PARSE_ERROR with source positions and a suggested extension-name hint) were precise and pointed directly at the offending token, supporting readable, low-friction iteration. Minor readability friction: several idioms are non-obvious without consulting the spec (bare bin.parse returning T|error, no bare 'input()', capital-letter bitwise operators AND/OR/XOR alongside lowercase logical and/or/n…
